module: Make and maintain the deployment decision

lesson.title: Implement instructions, oversight and input controls
lesson.summary: Implement instructed use with capable oversight and controlled-input quality.

prerequisites.reason: The person must be able to use effective oversight controls.

blocks: **Instructed use** requires appropriate technical and organisational measures to use a high-risk system according to its accompanying instructions. A supplier’s design obligations and an employer’s actual operating arrangements are different.

For Northbridge’s employer customer, map the permitted recruitment purpose, limits, maintenance and intervention arrangements to the actual workflow. Buying the service does not itself implement those measures.

**Oversight assignment** is to natural persons with the necessary competence, training, authority and support. Competence concerns ability to perform the task; authority and support enable them to act on it.

A trained recruiter who is forbidden to override a result is not an adequately empowered overseer. A senior title without the needed understanding is also insufficient. The system must separately enable effective controls.
Other Union or national duties still apply. The deployer remains free to organise its own resources and activities to implement the provider’s indicated oversight measures.
This freedom does not permit removing effective oversight. Record responsibilities and demonstrate that the arrangement works in the intended operating context.

**Controlled-input quality** under current Article 26(4) means ensuring inputs are relevant and sufficiently representative for the intended purpose to the extent the deployer controls them. It is distinct from provider dataset-development governance.

Case: the employer can change the candidate fields it submits. It must assess those controlled inputs; it cannot dismiss the duty because the supplier trained the model. Conversely, do not claim this paragraph makes it control unavailable upstream data.
